How to create a Crossplane Composition with multiple resources
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: full-stack
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XFullStack
  resources:
  - name: my-vpc
    base:
      apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: VPC
  - name: my-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
  - name: my-db
    base:
      apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: DBInstance'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD for a virtual machine
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xvirtualmachines.compute.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: compute.example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XVirtualMachine
    plural: xvirtualmachines
  claimNames:
    kind: VirtualMachine
    plural: virtualmachines
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              instanceType:
                type: string
              region:
                type: string'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane claim for a virtual machine
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: compute.example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: VirtualMachine
metadata:
  name: my-vm
spec:
  instanceType: t3.micro
  region: us-east-1
  compositionRef:
    name: xvirtualmachines.compute.example.crossplane.io'
